# Set up
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

load clean dataframes
```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
#source from data cleaning Rmarkdown file
source_rmd <- function(file, local = FALSE, ...){
  options(knitr.duplicate.label = 'allow')

  tempR <- tempfile(tmpdir = ".", fileext = ".R")
  on.exit(unlink(tempR))
  knitr::purl(file, output=tempR, quiet = TRUE)

  envir <- globalenv()
  source(tempR, local = envir, ...)
}
source_rmd('01_data_clean.Rmd')
```

load packages
```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(vegan)
library(emmeans)
library(car) #Anova
library(glmmTMB)
library(DHARMa) #glmmTMB model checking
library(ggeffects)
library(patchwork) #ggMarginal work around
```

# Figure 1

load data
```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
matSeeds_predict <- read_csv("data_clean/matSeeds_predict.csv")
disp_CI <- read_csv("data_clean/disp_CI.csv")
```

```{r}
var.seed_violin <- demo_fecund %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = drought, y = matSeeds, fill = drought, colour = drought)) +
  geom_errorbar(data = matSeeds_predict, aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), width = 0.1) +
  geom_point(data = matSeeds_predict, size = 2) +
  geom_violin(aes(colour = drought), alpha = 0.3) +
  scale_colour_manual(labels = c("control", "post-germination drought", "flowering drought"),
                    name = " ",
                    values = c("#4a9152", "#de9b71", "#9e6374")) +
  scale_fill_manual(labels = c("control", "post-germination drought", "flowering drought"),
                    name = " ",
                    values = c("#4a9152", "#de9b71", "#9e6374")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("d0" = "control", "d1" = "early \n drought", 
                              "d3" = "late \n drought")) +
  xlab(" ") +
  ylab("LRS (number of mature seeds)") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        text = element_text(size = 10))

var.seed_violin
#ggsave("figures/pop6_violin_plot.pdf", height = 5, width = 5, units = "in")

#percentile method
disp_logratio_plot <- disp_CI %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = drought, values_from = c(dispcoeff, upperci, lowerci)) %>% 
  mutate(
    ratio_d0 = dispcoeff_d0 / dispcoeff_d0,
    ratio_d1 = dispcoeff_d1 / dispcoeff_d0,
    ratio_d3 = dispcoeff_d3 / dispcoeff_d0,
    upperRatio_d0 = upperci_d0 / dispcoeff_d0, 
    upperRatio_d1 = upperci_d1 / dispcoeff_d0,
    upperRatio_d3 = upperci_d3 / dispcoeff_d0,
    lowerRatio_d0 = lowerci_d0 / dispcoeff_d0,
    lowerRatio_d1 = lowerci_d1 / dispcoeff_d0,
    lowerRatio_d3 = lowerci_d3 / dispcoeff_d0,
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(1:18, names_to = c("disptype", "drought"), values_to = "dispcoeff", names_sep = "_") %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = disptype, values_from = dispcoeff) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = log(ratio), x = drought, fill = drought, colour = drought)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = log(lowerRatio), ymax = log(upperRatio), width = 0.1)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(labels = c("control", "post-germination drought", "flowering drought"),
                    name = " ",
                    values = c("#4a9152", "#de9b71", "#9e6374")) +
  scale_fill_manual(labels = c("control", "post-germination drought", "flowering drought"),
                    name = " ",
                    values = c("#4a9152", "#de9b71", "#9e6374")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("d0" = "control", "d1" = "early \n drought", 
                              "d3" = "late \n drought")) +
  #scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-20, 20)) +
  xlab(" ") +
  ylab("Log ratio of dispersion parameter") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

disp_logratio_plot
#ggsave("figures/pop6_logratdisp_plot.pdf", height = 5, width = 5, units = "in")
```

# Figure 2

load data
```{r}
raw_corr <- read_csv("data_clean/raw_corr.csv")
pred_corr_heights <- read_csv("data_clean/pred_corr_heights.csv")
height_disp_coef <- read_csv("data_clean/height_disp_coef.csv")

#wrangle for figures and 
predrought_height <- grow_time %>% 
  filter(population == "p6" & drought == "d0" & expDayHeight <= 135 | # cutting off @ day 135 b/c before irrigation problems
           population == "p6" & drought == "d1" & expDayHeight <=135) %>%
  group_by(cellID) %>% 
  reframe(
    preDrought.Cm = case_when(expDayHeight == 16 ~ height.Cm,
                                 TRUE ~ NA)
  ) %>% 
  drop_na(preDrought.Cm)
```


```{r}
corr_heights_plot <- raw_corr %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = expDayHeight, y = r, group = drought)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, aes(colour = drought), position = position_dodge2(0.2)) +
  geom_ribbon(data = pred_corr_heights, aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, fill = drought), 
              alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_line(data = pred_corr_heights, aes(colour = drought), size = 0.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#4a9152", "#de9b71"),
                      name = " ",
                      labels = c("control", "post-germination drought")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#4a9152", "#de9b71"),
                      name = " ",
                      labels = c("control", "post-germination drought")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0,150,25)) +
  ylab("Pearson's Correlation Coefficient (r)") +
  xlab("Day of experiment") +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        #legend.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        legend.key = element_blank(),
        text = element_text(size = 10))

corr_heights_plot
#ggsave("figures/pop6_corday_plot.pdf", height = 5, width = 5, units = "in")

# raw height correlations
# day 30
raw_corr_30 <- grow_time %>% 
  filter(population == "p6" & drought == "d0" & expDayHeight == 30| population == "p6" & drought == "d1" & expDayHeight == 30) %>%
  dplyr::select(cellID, drought, height.Cm, expDayHeight) %>% 
  left_join(predrought_height, by = "cellID") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = preDrought.Cm, y = height.Cm, colour = drought)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(size = 0.5, method = 'lm', se = FALSE) + 
  scale_colour_manual(labels = c("control", "post-germination drought"),
                    name = " ",
                    values = c("#4a9152", "#de9b71")) +
  xlab("") + 
  ylab("") +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")

raw_corr_30
#ggsave("figures/pop6_corday30_plot.pdf", height = 3, width = 3, units = "in")

# day 92
raw_corr_92 <- grow_time %>% 
  filter(population == "p6" & drought == "d0" & expDayHeight == 92| population == "p6" & drought == "d1" & expDayHeight == 92) %>%
  dplyr::select(cellID, drought, height.Cm, expDayHeight) %>% 
  left_join(predrought_height, by = "cellID") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = preDrought.Cm, y = height.Cm, colour = drought)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(size = 0.5, method = 'lm', se = FALSE) + 
  scale_colour_manual(labels = c("control", "post-germination drought"),
                    name = " ",
                    values = c("#4a9152", "#de9b71")) +
  xlab("") + 
  ylab("") +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        text = element_text(size = 10))

raw_corr_92
#ggsave("figures/pop6_corday92_plot.pdf", height = 3, width = 3, units = "in")
```

```{r}
var_height_plot <- height_disp_coef %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = variance, x = expDayHeight, colour = drought)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lowerVar, ymax = upperVar), width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(0.5)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, position = position_dodge(0.5)) +
  scale_colour_manual(labels = c("control", "post-germination drought"),
                    name = " ",
                    values = c("#4a9152", "#de9b71")) +
  xlab("Experiment day") +
  ylab("Variance in height") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

var_height_plot
```

# Supplement

# Fig S.2

```{r}
raw_corr_plot <- grow_time %>% 
  filter(population == "p6" & drought == "d0" & expDayHeight <= 135 & expDayHeight > 9 | population == "p6" & drought == "d1" & expDayHeight <= 135 & expDayHeight > 9) %>%
  dplyr::select(cellID, drought, height.Cm, expDayHeight) %>% 
  left_join(predrought_height, by = "cellID") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = log(preDrought.Cm), y = log(height.Cm), colour = drought)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(size = 0.5, method = 'lm', se = FALSE) + 
  scale_colour_manual(labels = c("control", "post-germination drought"),
                    name = " ",
                    values = c("#4a9152", "#de9b71")) +
  theme_classic() + 
  facet_wrap(~ expDayHeight) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

raw_corr_plot
#ggsave("figures/thesis/pop6_rawcorr_plot.pdf", height = 8, width = 10.5, units = "in")
```


# Fig S.3

```{r}
raw_height_plot<- grow_time %>% 
  filter(population == "p6" & drought == "d0" & expDayHeight <= 135 | population == "p6" & drought == "d1" & expDayHeight <= 135) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = expDayHeight, y = height.Cm, group = repID)) +
  geom_smooth(aes(linetype = drought, colour = drought), se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(labels = c("control", "post-germination drought"),
                    name = " ",
                    values = c("#4a9152", "#de9b71")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(20, 40, 60, 80, 100, 120, 140)) +
  xlab("Day of experiment") +
  ylab("Height (cm)") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

raw_height_plot
```

# Fig S.6

load data
```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
pred_germ <- read_csv("data_clean/pred_germ.csv")

germ_grow <- grow_time %>% 
  filter(population == "p6" & drought == "d0" & expDayHeight == 135 |
           population == "p6" & drought == "d1" & expDayHeight == 135) 
```

```{r}
germ_height_plot <- pred_germ %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = height.Cm, x = germination, group = drought, colour = drought)) +
  geom_point(data = germ_grow, alpha = 0.4, position = position_dodge(0.5)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), 
                width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(0.5)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, position = position_dodge(0.5)) +
  scale_colour_manual(labels = c("control", "early\ndrought"),
                    name = " ",
                    values = c("#4a9152", "#de9b71")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("exp" = "experimental \n germination", 
                              "nat" = "natural \n germination")) +
  xlab(" ") +
  ylab("Height (cm)") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

germ_height_plot
#ggsave("figures/pop6_germHeight_plot.pdf", height = 3, width = 3, units = "in")
```
